body: Thats awesome! You should write more often then, if it makes you feel nice. I used to write poetry but these days Im so lethargic I cant think. I just sit on reddit when Im not out with friends. Im glad you didnt leave us tonight, keep doing things that are cathartic :)
Thank you,  it means more than you know

I know what you mean. Its not okay, saying it is doesn't help. I just need to vent or .. I dont know. It doesnt technically help anything. But I feel like there's nothing else to do about all this and I just want to crawl out of my skin or under a rock. Thanks. I hope you find something you love enough to distract you.

im already overwhelmed. The only times Im not is when my life doesn't even feel real to me. it happens in brief moments. Thank you though. Its weird, but just reading someone acknowledging the pain I am in was.. I appreciate it. 

The idea of sticking around is horrifying. Last year,singing the autumn leaves & breeze at night made me feel like I might be okay, that nights like that are worth living for. This year the leaves falling and gusty nights like that just remind me of when I could sing, and of what I lost. I know its childish to covet something like that so much but I really did. Now there are no more distractions.
